items.exampleEn: The photographer told everyone to stand in a line.
items.exampleZh: 攝影師叫大家站成一排。

items.exampleEn: This painter is famous for his pictures of the sea.
items.exampleZh: 這位畫家以畫海景聞名。

items.exampleEn: We went on a long hike in the mountains.
items.exampleZh: 我們去山上健行了很長一段路。

items.exampleEn: The balloon flew up into the sky.
The hotel has a leisure center with a pool.
items.exampleZh: 這家飯店有附游泳池的休閒中心。

items.exampleEn: She started playing the violin at five.
I listen to music with my headphones on the train.
items.exampleZh: 我在火車上戴耳機聽音樂。

items.sentenceEn: We need some balloons for the party.
items.sentenceZh: 我們的派對需要一些氣球。

items.audioEn: In my free time, I like to paint and play the violin.
items.audioZh: 空閒時，我喜歡畫畫和拉小提琴。
items.questionZh: 說話的人空閒時做什麼？
options: Watch TV with the whole family

items.sentenceZh: 這位畫家用了鮮豔的顏色。

items.sentenceEn: This hike takes about three hours.
items.sentenceZh: 這段健行大約要三個小時。

items.stemEn: Please use your ____. The baby is sleeping.

items.passageEn: Leo has many hobbies. In his leisure time, he loves photography, and he takes his camera on every hike. Last month, he took photos at his cousin's wedding. Everyone said he was as good as a real photographer. His sister is a painter, and she likes to paint his best photos.
items.passageZh: Leo 有很多嗜好。空閒時間他最愛攝影，每次去健行都會帶著相機。上個月，他在表哥的婚禮上拍照，大家都說他跟真正的攝影師一樣厲害。他的姊姊是畫家，喜歡把他最好的照片畫成畫。

questions.questionZh: Leo 空閒時最愛做什麼？
Leo 的姊姊喜歡做什麼？
options: 每個週末都帶著相機到山上去健行
晚上在附近的咖啡店彈鋼琴給客人聽
把 Leo 最好的照片畫成畫

referenceEn: I want to learn to play the violin.
I want to learn how to play the violin.
rubricZh: 「拉小提琴」可寫例如 play the violin（寫 play violin、learn the violin 也正確）
「想學」可寫例如 want to learn to、want to learn how to

items.instructionZh: 用 leisure 造一個句子，說說你空閒時間喜歡做什麼。
referenceEn: I spend my leisure time with my family.
Reading is my favorite leisure activity.
rubricZh: leisure 表示「空閒；休閒」（例如 leisure time、a leisure activity）
主詞和動詞要搭配（例如 Reading is）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：疑似過嚴：「play the violin（the 不可省略）」——美式口語 play violin 亦常見；建議改「例如 play the violin」，不把 the 當必要條件，或僅作提醒。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "「拉小提琴」可寫例如 play the violin（寫 play violin、learn the violin 也正確）"（原 "「拉小提琴」用 play the violin（the 不可省略）"）；放寬，不把 the 當必要條件（第③關疑似 S4 一併收 learn the violin）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 第②關：疑似：cousin 譯為「表哥」多加性別與長幼資訊（輕微）。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 不改（語感類，執行長授權判斷）：中文沒有不分性別長幼又自然的 cousin 譯法，沿用「表哥」慣例；兩道閱讀題都不考這一點
